coinAutoCollect: Silver and gold coins begin the original collection flight after 60 active game ticks, without mouse/touch input. Native scoring, amounts and sounds are unchanged. Pauses, dialogs, non-playing scenes and already-collected coins are guarded. Sun, diamonds, seeds, bags and awards keep their existing behavior; present-fanout coins keep their native 80-tick collection.
branding: Original logo retained with the same generated transparent NB版 badge on the web loader, native title and main menu. One short settling entrance on the title; no perpetual motion. Main menu art sits below the user signs in the left sky, follows the achievements slide, has no hit target and clears when starting adventure. Native sandbox entry is 138x38 at (650,8), with 18px bitmap text and matching mouse/touch bounds.

sandboxScenes.switch: In-place terrain change preserving live plant IDs, health, heat and coin stocks. Sixth-row occupants temporarily share row five on land and return when six lanes are restored. Real missing lily/pot supports are added without consuming existing plants.
sandboxScenes.selector: Six original-background thumbnails with native pool overlays; dedicated top-bar map and every-lane buttons, separate from settings.
sandboxScenes.swimming: Sandbox-only automatic native duck rings, including sized rings for nonstandard land rigs. Snorkel and dolphin keep native aquatic poses; flying units and the boss are not forced to swim.
sandboxScenes.combo: Successful held/clicked placements chain into a short, fading COMBO counter; release, focus loss and menus stop repetition.
sandboxScenes.zombieCatalogue: All 33 native types, including Zomboss, plus eight originals; two pages. Linked bobsled followers use the chosen location. Sandbox boss deaths do not award adventure loot or wipe other enemies.

mode: Fifteen abstract plants and eight independent zombies (212..219). Coin Shooter is an independent card unlocked at 2-2; Coin Flower replaces Marigold. Adventure and sandbox share replacements; other progression and saves are preserved.
almanacCopy: All fifteen original plants and eight original zombies show explicit numeric statistics separately from surreal character-specific flavour text. Native cost/recharge footer and full supplemental Chinese glyphs.
almanacLayout: Original eight-column 50x70 cards aligned to the printed book sockets. Native seed order on page one; five extra plants on page two. Native book arrows, mouse/touch/keyboard navigation and page-scoped hit tests.

flower.name: 撒币花
flower.range: Current and eight adjacent cells; actual orbit contact, not aura damage

coinPlants.art: Original peashooter and marigold rigs, original coin and diamond images; pixel black sunglasses follow the face bone, cigarette follows the pea muzzle. Battle and card previews share the same accessory artwork and registration.
coinPlants.boundaries: Money ammunition is not a pickup. Single-target damage only; no automatic refund or sun debit. Adventure charges the reduced ammunition price and retains unaffordable pending rolls. Sandbox ammunition is free at any balance, including zero. Orbit coins persist after impact, with a contact latch preventing frame-by-frame damage; leaving and re-entering permits another hit. Its disposable profile never changes adventure savings.
coinPlants.save: Optional portable chunk 25 uses a -2 format marker and saves production clocks, pending rolls, orbit phases, 50 coin slots and contact target IDs. Legacy 100-slot saves migrate, keeping up to 50 highest-value coins. Restoring never charges the wallet again.

removedZombatar: The Zombatar menu sign and button are removed, with no click target, editor construction or editor resource preload. Legacy entry points are inert. Existing player records, combat zombies, almanac and other menu functions are preserved.

everythingShooter.boundaries: All ammunition damages at most its single collision target, including bombs, corn cob, fireballs and melons. Corn cob has its own 2% weight and is excluded from the 74% pool of thirteen other native types. Native impact artwork, lob paths, butter and target chill remain. No craters, terrain damage, friendly fire or extra poop control. Original plants keep their area damage. Saved projectile identity never rerolls.
everythingShooter.art: Original peashooter rig and native projectile/plant artwork reused. Ammunition follows the head bone. One generated transparent dung sprite, documented in art/everything-shooter/generation.json.

iceChili.art: Native Jalapeno rig recoloured ice blue; original ink, stalk, eyes, shading and bone registration preserved. Native ice shards and frozen-zombie blocks.
iceChili.boundaries: Same-row hostile on-board zombies only; preserve longer freeze and existing chill. No knockback, added lingering slow or terrain. Original Jalapeno and non-adventure Zen Garden sprouts unchanged. Native enum IDs and save object layouts preserved.

stinkShroom.name: 喷粪菇
stinkShroom.hitRoll: One mutually exclusive roll per struck ground walker: 50% stun, 5% flee, 10% knockback, 35% normal hit
stinkShroom.aura: Eight surrounding cells, 2000 continuous exposure ticks, production and attack frequency reduced by 30%; no stacking, restores immediately when no awake source is nearby. All Stink Shrooms are immune, including adjacent ones and old-save exposure.
stinkShroom.art: Native cap, spout and tip recoloured cocoa brown in battle/cards/almanac; pale-green body unchanged. Affected other plants turn green and shed a large native blue waterdrop following their face bone. Colours and waterdrops stop on recovery. Dark brown spray and native disgust SFX, no floating text.
stinkShroom.save: Optional portable chunk 24 retains exposure, stun, continuous push and fleeing without changing native object layouts

nukeShroom.name: 核爆菇
nukeShroom.damage: Native ApplyBurn per pulse (1800), enemies on the board only
nukeShroom.art: Native rig with animated green energy veins and green native mushroom clouds; mild green screen wash. Nine cells form one large crater, including at board edges.
nukeShroom.save: Remaining pulses and crater lifetime use portable native GridItem fields
nukeShroom.nativeRules: Daytime sleep, coffee awakening and detonation windup preserved

tinyPuff.name: 真·小喷菇
tinyPuff.layout: centre, bottom-left, bottom-right, left, right; stable independent poses
tinyPuff.nativeRules: short range, attack cadence and daytime sleep preserved

coneVariants.art: Original cone textures and native hat bone. Green preserves white bands, outlines and all damage stages. Tower nests twenty cones, losing one per 370 armor damage; bottom cone stays registered to the original head. Scoped visuals preserve ordinary zombies.
coneVariants.font: 雪糕桶包裹我 name unchanged. Missing 裹, 叠 and 绿 use complete CoreText STKaiti glyph outlines, rasterized to existing bitmap font ink bounds, advance, baseline and colour. No assembled radicals.

cleverZombies.slowMotion: 1.6 seconds per flip. The middle 0.8 seconds covers 16% of rotation and travel. C1-continuous takeoff/landing; one local progress curve drives rotation, horizontal travel, lane interpolation and height. Other entities and game clocks keep normal speed. Legacy mid-flight saves complete their original 90-tick trajectory.
cleverZombies.animation: Generated smug face without glasses; an angular jaw with prominent crease marks appears on flips, lane changes and steals. Shared skull registration on the native head bone; original body, cone and duck ring. Two-tile flight follows a continuous slow-motion arc. No global time scaling. Carries the stolen native plant frame. No bucket variant.

cactusPalm.art: Opaque wrist (6,29) registers inside native lip opening (5,13.5), drawn over its dark fill. Original mouth connector and lip images are retained; previews and projectile launch share that exact attachment transform. Existing generated asset, no redraw.

giantImp.art: Native imp rig and body; native giant head and independent jaw share one neck anchor and hinged jaw strike. Scoped transforms preserve ordinary imps, giant-carried imps, previews and death art.
giantImp.spawn: First eligible ordinary land-lane entry in waves 2,6,10,...; never converts native or thrown imps.
giantImp.attack: Kills the current native melee target at impact, with a visible windup/recovery and normal freeze, targeting and plant-interaction gates. No area kill, extra armor, throwing or knockback.

smallNut.art: Original wall-nut rig, blink and two damaged faces, scaled around the same ground anchor with a smaller shadow. Passive blocking only; no bite.

coneWrapZombie.name: 雪糕桶包裹我
coneWrapZombie.art: Exactly twenty native cones form the entire character. All anatomical and clothing textures are replaced, including zero armor, portraits and burn/death. Original cone damage textures and draw-only bone scopes. No external art.

tuckingProduction: Tucked sunflowers pause their native production countdown and cannot spawn suns. Standing resumes the exact remaining time, including save/resume; each sun stays worth 25 and the standing production rate is unchanged.
tuckingPoolSupport: Standing and tucked sunflowers in pool squares disappear after losing their last living lily pad, including unsupported flowers restored from old saves. Land and lifted plants are unchanged.
mobileTextInput: Tappable native-widget overlay inside the fullscreen canvas container, with IME composition, native text/width limits, selection, deletion and ordered submit. Desktop keyboard behavior is unchanged.
